algorithmProof.barrierProof: Both coordinates are loaded before pass 0. Each pass begins with GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync, then every thread writes both coord outputs before any thread can pass the next barrier. Final barrier precedes output reads. No early return exists in ComputeFFT.

apex14PolishFindings.mathematicalProof: Normal pass and cross-fade pass together can target the same LOD buffer, but each instance contributes at most one normal LOD and at most one cross-fade LOD. For distance cross-fade, target k receives normalLOD(k) plus cfFromLOD(k-1), disjoint subsets of safeInstanceCount. For animated cross-fade, target k receives normalLOD(k) plus oldLOD(k) where oldLOD != newLOD, also disjoint. Therefore per-target total is <= safeInstanceCount; if target capacity < safeInstanceCount, the only no-stall safe action is to skip the counter-preserving cross-fade pass.
